prompt: Create a Python 3.12 order application. When an order is confirmed, the application must send a notification. Define a notification service abstraction and provide a simple implementation that logs the notification instead of sending a real message.

intentions.text: I can confirm an order and receive a notification.
intentions.requires: an order with valid order ID and customer details
intentions.observable: a notification log entry indicating the order was confirmed

intentions.text: I can view logged notifications for confirmed orders.
intentions.requires: a list of notifications or logs from the notification service
intentions.observable: a list of notification messages showing order confirmation events

intentions.text: The application uses a notification service abstraction to send messages.
intentions.requires: a notification service interface defined in the code
intentions.observable: the notification service is used to log messages instead of sending real notifications
